title: Evaluation Metrics and Auto-Evaluation
summary: This module provides a suite of metrics for evaluating DSPy programs, including LLM-based auto-evaluation for semantic F1, answer completeness, and groundedness, alongside traditional metrics like exact match, token-level precision, and F1 scores.

nodes.label: Calculate Semantic F1 Score
nodes.title: SemanticF1
nodes.description: Computes semantic F1 between a prediction and ground truth using LLM-based precision and recall.

nodes.label: Assess Answer Completeness & Groundedness
nodes.title: CompleteAndGrounded
nodes.description: Combines scores for answer completeness and groundedness into a single metric, leveraging LLMs.

nodes.label: Define Semantic Recall/Precision
nodes.title: SemanticRecallPrecision
nodes.description: Signature for an LLM to compare a system's response to ground truth to compute recall and precision.

nodes.label: Define Decompositional Semantic Recall/Precision
nodes.title: DecompositionalSemanticRecallPrecision
nodes.description: Signature for an LLM to perform detailed recall/precision by enumerating key ideas and discussing overlap.

nodes.label: Define Answer Completeness
nodes.title: AnswerCompleteness
nodes.description: Signature for an LLM to estimate the completeness of a system's responses against ground truth.

nodes.label: Define Answer Groundedness
nodes.title: AnswerGroundedness
nodes.description: Signature for an LLM to estimate the groundedness of a system's responses against retrieved context.

nodes.label: Check Exact Answer Match
nodes.title: answer_exact_match
nodes.description: Evaluates if a predicted answer exactly matches or F1-threshold matches a reference answer.

nodes.label: Verify Passage Contains Answers
nodes.title: passage_has_answers
nodes.description: Checks if a given passage string contains any of the specified answers after normalization.

nodes.label: Calculate Token-Level Precision
nodes.title: precision_score
nodes.description: Computes token-level precision of a prediction against a reference after text normalization.

nodes.label: Calculate HotPotQA F1 Score
nodes.title: HotPotF1
nodes.description: Computes the maximum HotPotQA-style F1 score, specifically handling 'yes/no/noanswer' cases.

nodes.label: Match Answer to Passage Context
nodes.title: answer_passage_match
nodes.description: Determines if any passage in the prediction's context contains the reference answer(s).

nodes.label: Evaluate GSM8K Numeric Answer
nodes.title: gsm8k_metric
nodes.description: Compares parsed integer answers for evaluation on the GSM8K dataset.

nodes.label: Base Module
nodes.title: dspy.primitives.base_module.BaseModule
nodes.description: The foundational class for all DSPy modules, providing core functionality and structure.

nodes.label: Signature Definition
nodes.title: dspy.signatures.signature.SignatureMeta
nodes.description: Defines the input and output fields for an LLM call, structuring the prompt and response.

nodes.label: Chain of Thought Strategy
nodes.title: dspy.predict.ChainOfThought
nodes.description: A prediction strategy that encourages the Language Model to generate intermediate reasoning steps.

nodes.label: DSPy Example
nodes.title: dspy.Example
nodes.description: Represents a single input-output example used for training, development, or evaluation in DSPy.

nodes.label: DSPy Prediction
nodes.title: dspy.Prediction
nodes.description: Represents the output generated by a DSPy program or module for a given input.

groups.label: LLM-based Auto-Evaluation
groups.title: LLM-based Auto-Evaluation Metrics
groups.description: Metrics that leverage Language Models to automatically evaluate program responses based on semantic understanding, completeness, and groundedness.

groups.label: Auto-Evaluation Signatures
groups.title: Auto-Evaluation Signatures
groups.description: Signatures defining the prompts and expected outputs for LLM-based auto-evaluation tasks.

groups.label: Exact Match & Passage Metrics
groups.title: Exact Match & Passage Metrics
groups.description: Metrics focused on direct string or passage content matching for evaluation.

groups.label: Token & F1-based Metrics
groups.title: Token & F1-based Metrics
groups.description: Metrics that evaluate outputs based on token-level overlap and F1 scores, including specialized F1 variants.
